analysis.reasonEn: After 3 consecutive days of RSI neutral consolidation and sustained MACD improvement, today RSI fell to 47.4, consolidating in the neutral zone with slowing MACD histogram improvement. 5 consecutive daily closes in the red indicate persistent downward pressure. Falling below the 20-day moving average (245,125 KRW) signals potential bearish shift. ADX at 19.7 indicates a non-trending phase. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (247,500 KRW) vs SMA5/20/50 (262,800/245,125/283,297 KRW) — short-term resistance, below mid-term support, above long-term support.
· Position vs SMA100/200 (264,332/201,839 KRW) — above mid-to-long-term trend, strength maintained.
· 52-week position (58.6%) + historical mid-range price level.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (45.5→47.1) + post-oversold escape neutral range consolidation + weakening directionality.
· MACD histogram trajectory (1698.5576→5224.4038) + improvement diagnosis + potential trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band 245,125 KRW) + 31.51% band width level.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (240,000 KRW) + pivot (241,567 KRW) based.
· Swing resistance (267,000 KRW) + expectation of uptrend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low recovery initiation) + trend recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.95x) + normal confidence in movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation phase) + consider buy entry upon confirmation of 240,000 KRW support.
